items.quote: Lion Thaldovan spearheaded user research with residents on the new app at the national level.
She took ownership of trialling a fresh approach to permit queues and steered it to completion.
She set the direction for the scenario planning exercise on future workforce needs across the public service.
She headed accountability arrangements for public funds, setting priorities for several teams.
She spearheaded drafting legislative amendments for the new act at the national level.
Lion Thaldovan contributed effectively to presentations to senior management.
Lion set the direction for the overnight response when the haze situation escalated across the public service.
Lion Thaldovan drove bilateral negotiations on the water agreement for the whole division.
She drove tracing how a delay in one agency rippled through to others for the whole division.
She led process improvement in licensing operations across the department.
She contributed effectively to the organisational restructuring of the department.
She was recognised sector-wide for her leadership of cross-agency collaboration on the joint taskforce.
Lion headed engagement with industry stakeholders, setting priorities for several teams.
She handled the use of survey numbers to decide where to put new clinics competently within her team.
She set the direction for steadying a team facing adversity across the public service.
